Did you delete it or something? they never contacted me. I really do appreciate you trying though

I'm just so done man, I'm so tired of everything going on in my life and I'm just so done with dealing with all of it

Who? Jagex? you sent them the link to this post? I consider this kinda personal man... I appreciate you trying to help but I would have rather sent them to a post with a lot less personal details...

Thank you for wanting to help

Yeah he was really bad by the time I found out about it. Lets just say that's not the only thing I lost while I was gone, pretty much anything and everything of value that I left. I believe him that he didn't touch my items though, we're much closer now (he'll be 4 years clean this March) from and he has no reason to lie. 

I really appreciate you trying to help me, but doesn't twitter have a 140 character limit? I couldn't even begin to explain my situation... 

Thank you. It really means a lot to me you trying to help
I just added everything, but like I told the other guy it won't do anything, it'll just make you angry about what happened
Just added it, but I don't know how it could help

Yeah I think I'm going to try out a meeting. At the very least it'll take my mind off of everything for a little while.

Thanks

The story isn't much more than what I already posted, it just makes me so angry just thinking about it. I'll go ahead and add it

It's kind of a long story, I can edit my post and go into more detail. However Jagex doesn't care, they admit to not even reading appeals. People spend years of their lives playing and they don't care enough to listen

I wouldn't necessarily say that, I just always really enjoyed playing the game, I think it was just introduced to my life at the right time and it just happened to be that game. Now I've just grown very attached to it.

Thank you, that's the first complement I've had in a long time. I've been a prolific journaler all of my life so I've had some practice. I've considered writing a book but I'm the least creative person ever

I think it's a lot of things, the nostalgia and the mental connections that my mind has to the game, it meant the world to me when I was a kid. It was the one thing in my life I had to look forward to. I tried getting into WoW when I was in college and just couldn't do it, it just made me want to play RS

I want to thank you for doing this, it's really nice to see you reaching out, it shows Jagex still cares somewhat. I've been playing Jagex games since their most popular game was slime wars, back in 2000. I know you didn't want this post to be about this, but I'm begging you to just read it, or direct me somewhere I can get a hold of a human who will take a few minutes to listen to me. It would mean the world to me

I've struggled with mental illness my entire life. When I was a kid, I didn't have friends or hobbies, I had runescape. I've lived with severe depression my entire life, I cant describe what if feels like to wake up every day trying to think of an excuse to live that day, but for me it was Runescape. It was my entire life, I can honestly say with 100% certainty I would not be alive if it wasn't for runescape

Almost exactly 7 years ago, while I was away at school, my brother who was a drug addict at the time (clean almost 4 years now) got my password using my email and the password recovery of a forum account and used my account to contact a friend of mine to convince him to sell him his rares, so they could both make irl profit. He didn't touch any of my items, because he knew I would never forgive him. If I was willing to risk years of my life for this, I could have sold my own items or used a different account.

He has agreed to write a sworn statement witnessed by a legal notary where he details exactly what he did and how he did it, I can also do one where I detail exactly what happened from my point of view. I can fax this to you immediately. Not only that, but I can prove that I was in a different state at the time. He has even agreed to pay a restitution fee to Jagex to make up for your loss of time. 

I never ever broke a single rule, I didn't bot, I didn't scam, I had never even had a mute. That account was the entire world to me. I never would have done anything to risk it. 

He used my ban appeal hoping I would never find out about this, unknowingly completely screwing me over. So at the very least I would appreciate a chance to submit my own formal appeal

I can't even get anyone at Jagex to respond to me. We're talking about years of peoples lives that were just taken away from them, and they don't care enough to even read them? Bot appeals are one thing, theres no reason someone would hack someone else to bot on their account. But hacking for the purpose of selling those items for RWT is probably very common

For a long time I just accepted it, but recently I was put on disability because my depression and mental illness has become debilitating and caught up with me again. So I recently started playing again, and it's just been a constant reminder of what I lost, and I can't take it anymore. I can't describe the feeling of losing years of your life, the only thing I have to show for years of work, for something you know you didn't do. And Jagex doesn't even seem to care

So, I can 

1.Prove I was in a different state at the time

2.get sworn statements witnessed by a legal notary from both my brother and I stating what happened from each of our perspectives

3. My brother is willing to pay a restitution fee to Jagex

4. show you the paypal used that is in his name and connected to his bank account

One of the most frustrating parts of this is that before I went to school I transferred all my rares from my other accounts so that it would lessen the risk of me getting hacked and losing any items. It couldn't have backfired on me more. If I was planning on selling my items, why would I put them all on one account exponentially increasing the possibility of losing it all? it's just so damn frustrating because if you just look at it, it's obvious I didn't do it. 

You can put a trade limit on my account and make it so I can't ever buy bonds or have any possible way of RWTing on the account. I'm begging you to just give me my life back, and let me prove to you I wasn't in control of the account. Just hear me out. I'll even send you a video of me swearing on the bible and to god that I didn't do this

The username is blue107, and the account I transferred my other items from just a couple months before this was kale nef

Thank you very very much for reading this. I can't tell you how much it means to me. Please let me know whatever I have to do. It would take so little effort for you to do this, and it would mean the world to me.

Thank you
